'''The Pilot's Lounge''' was a business that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="FAE" /> According to an [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] advertisement, it featured a live [[Band/Legends|band]] every [[Standard day/Legends|night]]. Two [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] were pictured on the ad, along with an illustration of [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverages]].<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-trivia-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Signage at the fueling station includes: Eat at Koe's, Bounty Emporium: Always Open, Bounty Never Sleeps; Security Services; Speeder Sales; The Pilot's Lounge (Live Band Every Night); Craft Repair and Maintenance; Repair Rack Droid Services; Orondia Tours; and Meteor Cafe.|Friends and Enemies Trivia Gallery|<ref name="Trivia" />}}
The Pilot's Lounge was first mentioned on a sign appearing in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Friends and Enemies]].<ref name="FAE" />
